GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG729.3 (1 Mar 47) PM
(SCAPIN - 1550)
APO 500
1 March 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Road Traffic of Pedestrians.
1． Reference is made to C. L. O. Memorandum No. 6127(IHW), dated 19 November 1946, subject: Road Traffic of Pedestrians.
2． Approval is given to the request made in par. 2 of the memorandum to continue the traffic regulations hitherto in force which require Japanese pedestrians to walk on the left side of the road in the direction of traffic.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
